explanation: He ran 1 hour 59 minutes 40 seconds in Vienna, the first marathon distance run in under two hours. It is unofficial, because pacers rotated in and drinks came by bicycle.

claims.text: Eliud Kipchoge is a Kenyan runner.
Eliud Kipchoge does not represent Ethiopia, Uganda or Eritrea.
In Vienna on 12 October 2019 Kipchoge ran the marathon distance in 1 hour 59 minutes 40 seconds.
Kipchoge's 2019 Vienna run was the first time anyone covered the marathon distance in under two hours.
Kipchoge's Vienna run was not ratified as a world record because it used rotating pacemakers and drinks handed over from a bicycle.
